title: Functions and problem solving: cheat sheet

blocks.title: The big idea
blocks.body: A function is a named block of code. It takes arguments, may return a value, and keeps its own local variables. Break big problems into small functions, then test each one.

Named values
items: Name a number instead of a magic number

blocks.title: Solving a problem
items: Code one piece, then test it

blocks.body: A variable lives only inside its braces. Test the tricky cases, not just the easy ones.
